environment.note: Durable fix for the Windows SCM boot-time environment-cache defect (GFX-143): the hosted executor now reads its HMAC keyring FILE-FIRST from one fixed ACL-protected file, env loader retained as a documented migration fallback. No production deploy, Windows-host mutation, service restart, reboot, keyring mutation, allow-list enablement, bridge commit, Copy-Trading change or broker action by this packet.

ci.note: Exact-head Linux CI (backend/frontend/governance/market-data-foundation/research-foundation) to be driven to terminal after PR open; HARD STOP before merge. The PowerShell provisioner + Pester tests are validated on a Windows PowerShell 5.1 host out-of-band (repo convention: ci.yml has no Windows runner); the daemon loader BEHAVIOUR is covered by the backend job.

commands: python3 -c "<daemon_config file-first loader smoke: fallback / file-primary / over-permissive / malformed-fail-closed / active-absent>"
expected_results: GuvFXHostedExecutor reads its HMAC keyring FILE-FIRST from HOSTED_EXECUTOR_KEYRING_FILE / DEFAULT_KEYRING_FILE with explicit fail-closed parsing + validation; the env loader is used ONLY when the file is ABSENT (migration fallback); a present-but-bad file fails closed and never falls back; load_config records a non-secret keyring_source ('file'|'env').

Provision-GuvfxHostedExecutorKeyringFile.ps1 copies the machine-variable keyring + active id into the file value-blind (never printing/hashing/logging/returning/persisting either value elsewhere), atomic temp->restrict-ACL->write->read-back->rename, ACL inheritance off with only SYSTEM/Administrators/service-principal read; output only safe metadata; -Verify and -Remove; rotation supported.

Backend tests cover valid file load, missing->env fallback, malformed/over-permissive/active-absent/placeholder refusal, rotation, rollback and no-secret-leakage; Pester tests cover the same for the operator with synthetic keys.
actual_results: hosted_workspace.tests_host_daemon: Ran 37 tests, OK (local; +13 new KeyringFileLoaderTests + 1 env-source test). Covers: file-primary-over-env, absent->env fallback, malformed-file fail-closed (no fallback), over-permissive refused (POSIX), directory-at-path refused, active-id-absent refused, placeholder refused, rotation reflected, rollback (remove->env), both-absent fail-closed, error-messages-carry-no-secret.

daemon_config file-first loader smoke (local): fallback_source=env; file_source=file; over-permissive(0o644) refused; present-but-malformed fail-closed (not fallback); active-absent fail-closed. All as expected.

Provision-GuvfxHostedExecutorKeyringFile.ps1: ASCII-only (0 non-ASCII bytes), no BOM, #Requires 5.1; balanced delimiters by inspection. Pester suite Test-HostedExecutorKeyringFileProvisioner.Tests.ps1 added (synthetic keys only): provision+ACL+metadata, value-blind (no secret in output), well-formed {keyring,key_id}, verify, absent/malformed/empty-secret/active-absent/active-not-in-ring refusals, rotation, rollback(-Remove), seam-refused-in-production, write-failure cleanup, fixed-leaf violation.
Secret scan (check_no_secrets.py) + evidence linter (check_evidence_manifests.py): to be run at exact head; synthetic keys only in all tests; no secret value in any tracked file.
limitations: Repository-only. Making the live host use the file requires separate Sponsor-gated steps (run the provisioner over RDP; Restart-Service GuvFXHostedExecutor; confirm keyring_source=='file'). NOT performed by this packet.

ci.yml has no Windows/PowerShell runner (repo convention), so the PowerShell ParseFile (Windows PS 5.1, RULE 9) + Pester run are validated on a Windows host out-of-band, NOT in GitHub exact-head CI. The script is written ASCII-only so it parses encoding-independently; the daemon LOADER behaviour (the actual fix) is covered by the backend CI job. No local pwsh was available to run Pester at authoring time.

On Windows the daemon's over-permissive check is deferred to the NTFS ACL (operator-set + provisioner -Verify); the POSIX-mode refusal is exercised on Linux. A win32security DACL assertion in the daemon is a possible future hardening.

SECRET_INVENTORY.md's section D 'LIVE keyrings' pre-existed uncommitted in the working tree (2026-11-15 rotation work); this PR brings it forward together with the ADR-0112 file-first additions (flagged in the PR). No secret VALUES are introduced (key IDs only).
